card.name: Then resume after withholding a drug
card.fires_on: The word "then" (or "the" right after "then resuming") that follows a withhold-until-recovery condition and comes just before "resume" in dose-modification instructions.

modes.label: then before resume
modes.description: "then" after a recovery condition such as a Grade or ULN threshold, leading into resuming the drug.
modes.example: Withhold ALUNBRIG until recovery to Grade 1 or less (less than or equal to 3× ULN) or to baseline,<< then>> resume ALUNBRIG at next lower

modes.label: the after then resuming
modes.description: "the" after "then resuming" following a dose decrease or stopping, before "previously prescribed dose".
modes.example: then resuming<< the>> previously prescribed dose may be considered.
